text:
Jen S.: FYI, Acme wants a POC next Tue. They need Hosted API keys, a short Dedicated pool trial, and a Private/VPC evaluation path. Top asks: audit logs (format + retention), who can view them, and answers for the security questionnaire. Can we scope access and timelines?
Sam R.: I can handle the Hosted keys + Dedicated trial. For VPC we'll need network contact + CIDR. Do we know their compliance baseline? SOC2/fedramp/etc?
Jen S.: They ticked SOC2 and want KMS + SSO. Security questionnaire attached in the thread (see doc link).
Leo K.: Quick summary from sec: we can provide audit logs for Hosted and Dedicated. Hosted logs are redacted by default (no raw prompt export). Dedicated can include more fields; Private gives the customer full control. Retention: default 30 days, can contract up to 365 days. Need DPA + explicit consent for raw prompt retention.
Alex M.: Ops note: for Dedicated POC we can provision a 2xA10G pool (or similar) within ~48 hours after the request and PO. Hosted scoped API key can be issued same day. Private/VPC needs network handoff and a 2–3 day window for infra prep.
Maria O.: I'll draft temp assets: (1) scoped Hosted API key template with rate limits and model whitelist, (2) Dedicated POC sizing checklist, (3) audit-log sample export (JSONL).
Sam R.: For sales copy, here's a short SOW blurb you can paste: 
````
During the POC, Redwood will provide system audit logs including request_id, timestamp, model_version, latency, and outcome codes. Raw prompt text will not be exported or persisted outside the platform unless the customer signs an explicit data sharing agreement. Default log retention is 30 days; extended retention (up to 365 days) is available under enterprise terms. Access to logs is role-restricted and requires SSO/RBAC configuration.
````
Jen S.: Perfect. Can we also get exact field names and a sample log line so their infra team can validate ingestion?
Maria O.: Sample JSONL line (example):
````
{"request_id":"req_01FF2A3B","ts":"2024-10-01T14:22:31Z","model":"redwood-medic-v1","user_id":"acme-uid-12","prompt_hash":"sha256:...","tokens_in":128,"tokens_out":64,"status":"complete"}
````
Note: prompt_text omitted unless signed.
Leo K.: Encryption: logs at rest are encrypted with platform KMS. For Private deployments we can integrate customer-managed AWS KMS or an HSM. For Hosted logs to be exported to customer S3, we can sign deliveries and optionally use SSE-KMS with the customer's key.
Alex M.: Networking ask for Private: need a CIDR for the VPC peering, list of egress IPs (we'll provide), and a contact for routing rules. If they want on-prem, we'll schedule the agent install and coordinate a short maintenance window.
Sam R.: For the security questionnaire: I'll answer the audit questions (where logs live, retention, access controls, encryption) and loop in Leo for crypto questions.
Leo K.: Two follow-ups: 1) If Acme requests raw prompt retention we need a legal-approved clause in the DPA; 2) RBAC: suggest enabling admin and auditor roles — auditors get read-only logs, admins can view metadata but not raw prompts by default.
Maria O.: I'll prepare the json schema for the logs and S3 export instructions (presigned-put vs direct push). ETA to Jen: artifacts by EOD today.
Jen S.: Great — timeline summary for the customer: Hosted scoped key same-day, Dedicated 48–72h, Private/VPC 3–7 business days pending network handoff and contract. Is that accurate?
Alex M.: Yep. Also note: Dedicated pool requires a short commit form (POC terms) to enable reserved infra.
Maria O.: Created temp Hosted key artifact and draft SOW in GDrive: https://redwood.example/g/poctools (sharing link).
deploy-bot: project-poc-acme: dedicated-pool request accepted, ticket #POC-4421 created.
Jen S.: Thanks all. I'll send the SOW + questionnaire answers to Acme and set a kickoff for Mon. If anything blocks (network contact or DPA signature), flag here. :thumbsup:
